props.heading: Jewellery you can wear for a lifetime
props.sub: Bridal sets, solitaires and handcrafted gold from Jaipur's Johari Bazaar — every piece BIS hallmarked, every gem certified, every price transparent. Available in-store and online.

props.label: Our Heritage
props.heading: Four generations of jewellers, one workshop
props.body:
Aarna Jewels began in 1991 as a two-bench workshop behind Johari Bazaar, making bridal gold for families who knew exactly which bench made their piece.

Thirty-five years later we are still one workshop — the same goldsmiths' families, the same bench tradition, just more of it. Every piece is made in-house: waxed, carved, set and finished by our own artisans. We do not buy ready stock from a karigar's factory, and we do not outsource.

Every gold item we sell carries a BIS Hallmark, every solitaire ships with its IGI grading report, and every bill is broken down at the day's live gold rate with the making charge shown separately. You will always know exactly what you are paying for.

pillars.title: 100% BIS Hallmarked
pillars.text: Every gold piece is hallmarked at a BIS-recognised centre — the purity is on the piece, not just our word.

pillars.title: Certified Diamonds
pillars.text: Every solitaire carries an IGI grading report. What we quote on the card is what you get.

pillars.title: In-House Artisans
pillars.text: Waxed, carved, set and finished in our own workshop — never outsourced to a factory.

pillars.title: Transparent Pricing
pillars.text: Billed at the day's live gold rate with the making charge shown separately. No surprises.

props.label: The Collection
props.heading: Shop signature pieces
props.sub: Pick your purity and finish on any piece — live stock, add to cart, and pay however suits you. Every gold piece is BIS hallmarked and billed at the day's live rate.

items.title: Rajwadi Bridal Gold Set
items.desc: Handcrafted 22K gold bridal set with uncut kundan and polki diamonds — necklace, matching earrings and maang tikka.
items.body:
Our signature bridal set, made the same way for three generations: uncut kundan set into warm 22K gold, finished with hand-shaped polki diamonds.

The set includes the necklace, a pair of matching earrings and a maang tikka. Every piece is carved and set in-house, then hallmarked at a BIS-recognised centre before it reaches the counter.

Because gold is billed at the live rate, the price above is for the set as shown. Choose 18K for a lighter piece, or the antique finish for the deep, almost matte look that photographs best for weddings. Made to order in two to three weeks; a 25% advance confirms your order.

Delivery across India is insured and signature-on-delivery. A complimentary cleaning and a one-year warranty on settings are included.

items.title: Solitaire Diamond Ring
items.desc: A 0.50 ct IGI-certified round brilliant solitaire, set in 18K gold with a classic six-prong mount.
items.body:
A round brilliant solitaire, exactly 0.50 carat, graded and certified by IGI with the report number engraved inside the band.

Set in 18K gold with a six-prong mount that keeps the stone high and bright. Choose yellow, white or rose gold — white gold arrives rhodium-plated for that icy sparkle.

Each ring is sized to order. If you are not sure of your size, we will send a free ring sizer before making the ring, or size it free after delivery. Insurance valuation certificate included.

Delivery across India is insured. If you would like to see the actual stone before purchase, book a private viewing and we will have it at the store.

items.title: Gold Jhumka Earrings
items.desc: Classic 22K gold jhumkas with a filigree dome, tiny bells and a pearl drop.
items.body:
The pair that started Aarna: a traditional jhumka with a filigree dome, a row of tiny swinging bells, and a pearl drop.

The antique finish gives them the deep, muted look that works with a lehenga and a plain kurta alike. Made in-house, hallmarked, and guaranteed to match the weight on your bill.

The medium size suits most faces; go large for the full bridal presence. Choose 18K for a lighter daily-wear pair.

Insured delivery across India. Screw-backs available at no extra cost if your lobes are not pierced.

items.title: Men's Gold Kada & Chain Set
items.desc: A bold 22K gold kada and rope chain — classic for weddings, sharp for everyday.
items.body:
A full-weight 22K gold kada paired with a rope chain, made for men who wear their gold as jewellery, not ornament.

The kada has a screw-and-pin closure that sits flush — it does not catch cuffs. The chain is a solid rope weave, not hollow, so it wears heavy and holds its shape.

Choose the matte finish for something understated, or polished to match a sherwani. Both options are hallmarked and billed at the day's live gold rate.

Sizing note: the kada is available in 2.2-inch and 2.4-inch diameters. Measure an existing kada across the inside before ordering.

items.title: Antique Gold Bangles
items.desc: A set of four antique-finish 22K gold bangles with a hand-hammered edge.
items.body:
Four antique-finish 22K bangles, each with a hand-hammered edge and a smooth inner face so they sit comfortably on the wrist.

The set stacks to a full, traditional wrist — pair with the jhumkas for a complete everyday-to-festive look.

Each bangle is hallmarked. Weights vary slightly piece to piece as they are hand-made; your bill lists the exact weight of the set you receive.

Available in medium (2.6 inch) and large (2.8 inch) inside diameters. We can open or close the sizing free of charge if they need adjusting.

items.title: Kundan Choker Set
items.desc: An heirloom kundan choker with matching earrings — uncut diamonds in warm gold.
items.body:
A kundan choker that sits close to the neck, finished with hand-shaped polki diamonds and matching earrings.

Kundan is our slowest craft — every stone is set by hand, one at a time, in a technique that has not changed in a century. The choker takes up to three weeks to make.

Choose 22K for the classic piece or 18K for a lighter, daily-wearable version. Both are hallmarked and come with a one-year warranty on settings.

This is the piece customers most often commission for a bride, so allow three weeks if you need it for a specific date.

posts.excerpt: What is safe to clean at home, what needs a jeweller, and the one thing you should never do to your gold (hint: it involves a toothbrush and toothpaste).

items.a: Yes — every gold piece we sell carries a BIS Hallmark with the purity mark (22K shows 916, 18K shows 750), the BIS logo, our jeweller's mark and the assaying centre's mark. It is engraved on the piece itself, not just printed on the bill.

Your bill is split into two parts: the gold, billed at the day's live market rate for the exact weight of your piece, and the making charge, quoted separately as a percentage or a flat figure before you buy. Nothing is hidden in a combined price.

items.q: Do you buy old gold? How is it valued?
items.a: Yes. We test and weigh your old gold in front of you, value it at the live market rate for its purity, and either pay you by transfer or apply the amount towards anything in the store. There is no deduction for 'impurity' unless the test genuinely finds it.

items.q: Can I design my own piece?
items.a: Absolutely. Bring a sketch, a photograph or just an idea, and our design team will work up a CAD render and a fixed quote before any gold is touched. Custom pieces are made in-house in two to four weeks and take a 25% advance.

items.q: What is your exchange and return policy?
items.a: Ready-made pieces can be exchanged within 15 days for anything in the store, and sizing is free for life. Made-to-order pieces are non-returnable but carry a one-year warranty on settings and workmanship.

Every solitaire ships with its IGI grading report, and the report number is engraved inside the band. If you would like to see the actual stone before purchase, book a private viewing and we will have it at the store for you.
Every piece carries a one-year warranty on settings and workmanship, plus free ultrasonic cleaning and inspection for life. Beyond the first year, repairs are priced at cost with no service fee.

notes:
CONTENT MODEL: Built as a bridal & fine jewellery house (Aarna Jewels) in Jaipur's Johari Bazaar serving the Indian market. 14 sections — the same breadth as the wedding template, but product-led like the boutique template. The royal-maroon theme (deep maroon + antique gold, ivory background) is the natural fit and is linked both ways via the theme's industries array.

PRODUCTS: Six products form the shoppable catalogue and exercise the full products manifest — nested attributes (Purity/Finish, Metal/Ring Size, Weight/Size), per-combination pricing via variants with SKU, MRP and live stock, full body copy, productInfo tables and slugs for individual product pages. Purity (22K/18K) is the honest vertical for Indian gold; the solitaire ring adds a second attribute (Ring Size) across three metals. Some combinations are deliberately stock 0 to show the out-of-stock and disabled add-to-cart states.

PRICING: Jewellery prices are set at realistic Indian gold+jewellery market levels as of mid-2026 and reflect the day's-rate model in the copy — the starting prices assume roughly ₹1,10,000–1,20,000 per 10 g of 22K gold including average making charges. Weights stated 'as shown' are illustrative; the real bill lists exact weight, rate and making charge. Prices must be verified against the store's actual rate sheet before going live.

TRUST SIGNALS: BIS hallmarking, IGI certificates, live-rate billing and transparent making charges are woven through the hero, about pillars, stats, FAQ and terms — these are the decisive factors for Indian jewellery buyers and should be kept even when the copy is rewritten.

TEAM: First-name-and-surname roles with no photographs, following the salon.json/gym.json/wedding.json convention of not pairing stock photos with made-up names.

IMAGES: All photos are hosted Unsplash URLs using the ?auto=format&fit=crop&w=...&q=80 pattern (SiteRenderer::media passes any http(s) URL through). Some IDs are reused across sections deliberately, mirroring the boutique template; all must be swapped for the store's own photography before going live. Per-colour/per-option photos are intentionally not set on product attributes.

BUSINESS INFO: Address is set to Johari Bazaar, Jaipur — the traditional jewellery market. Phone, WhatsApp and email are placeholders to be replaced. SOCIAL: Instagram, Facebook and YouTube are the primary platforms for jewellery retail.
